name: Alakazam
description: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if there is any able to battle. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target drowsy.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells to restore its own HP.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.
